resources.string: Customize the SystemUI "Connected to VPN" ownership prompt
Live preview (auto-refreshes with config / device state)
(No intervention — showing the system default text)
e.g. This device belongs to me
e.g. This device is connected via Cocoon VPN
Enter the text to replace with (multi-line supported)
You have unsaved changes — tap "Apply" to save
On: lock screen uses its own config. Off: both share the current config. Tap the row to open the lock-screen config page. Takes effect after a SystemUI restart
Turn on "Separate control center & lock screen" first
When off, ${...} in text is NOT evaluated and is passed through as-is (never injected into SystemUI). Takes effect after a SystemUI restart
https uses a bundled self-signed certificate

This software is licensed under MPL 2.0 and will never charge a fee.
By no means will this software on its own: · connect outward (e.g. network, Bluetooth) · upload anything (e.g. logs) · download anything (e.g. malicious code) · harm the system
This software is an Xposed module that runs on the LSPosed framework. Without your authorization we cannot modify the system. Please also note that this software carries a small degree of risk.

We especially welcome feedback about resources that cannot be captured by auto-scan.
Please attach: · System information · SystemUI apk
If you don\'t know what this is, don\'t change it.
Manage the resource names of the "ownership + Connected to VPN" prompt. The built-in list ships with the module; you can add resource names detected on your device but missing from the list below.

On: when the "ownership + VPN" prompt appears on your device, it auto-detects new keys with renamed resources by matching the text. On a hit it rewrites immediately and auto-fills the custom list below. It auto-enables when resources are miss, and auto-disables after a hit.
(No new resource names captured yet. Turn on the scan and let the "ownership + VPN" prompt show once.)
A scan hit auto-disables the scan; if new keys remain unmatched, turn the scan on again to recapture.
Every entry takes effect directly on a hook hit. Resource names you see in logs as "detected disclosure key" can be added here to take effect long-term.
One resource name per line, e.g.: quick_settings_disclosure_named_management_named_vpn Comma or newline separated
Captured a new resource name and added it to the custom list
Gold bold = available on this device (exists, active); grey = absent, already pruned. Groups reflect each system\'s naming convention, for maintenance reference only.

Groups are only a maintenance reference for the naming source, not your system type. We especially welcome feedback about resources that cannot be captured by auto-scan; please attach system info and the SystemUI apk.
⚠ Resource miss: cannot modify ownership prompt · cannot modify VPN display
With Debug off: content scan off, custom list cleared, resource config frozen to the built-in list only.
